subject: Azure offer gatekeeper checklist: account binding + technical acceptance
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Azure Marketplace Support <marketplace-support@microsoft.com>, Patrick Lee <patrick.lee@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Azure offer gatekeeper checklist: account binding + technical acceptance

Hi team,

Getting ACME's offer past the Marketplace gatekeeper this week — quick summary and asks so we can close the loop:

- Goal: complete publisher account binding to ACME tenant + technical acceptance for SaaS offer (entitlement mapping + SPN proof) by EOD Friday.
- Blockers we hit: missing identity claim bundle, entitlement SKU mapping not present in payload, and a failing smoke test in the staging sandbox related to token-exchange.

I've attached a lightweight gatekeeper checklist (redwood_gatekeeper_checklist_v1.xlsx) that calls out the artifacts A-D we need to upload to the publisher portal. Patrick, can you confirm you can share the tenant evidence file and the co-sell contact? If you prefer, we can accept the evidence bundle via secure upload link.

Specific asks:
1) Azure team: can you validate whether the entitlement mapping in the offer JSON (SKU id -> ARM plan) is acceptable as-is, or do we need a manifest change?
2) ACME (Patrick): please upload the identity evidence zip and confirm the SPN shown in the README matches the SPN used for the token-exchange test.
3) Internal (Marissa / Karthik): please carve out 30 min tomorrow to join the sandbox replay and review the failing token-exchange trace — I can share logs.

I've included the HubSpot deal link for context. I want to avoid an extra manifest roundtrip if possible; if Microsoft can accept the entitlement clarifications in a separate evidence bundle, that will speed publish.

Thanks — Priyom

--
Priyom Das
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Azure Marketplace Support <marketplace-support@microsoft.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Patrick Lee <patrick.lee@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 13:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Azure offer gatekeeper checklist: account binding + technical acceptance

Hi Priyom / Patrick,

Thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers inline:

- Entitlement mapping: We can accept an "entitlement evidence" bundle if the SKU -> ARM plan mapping is stable and you provide a sample test request/response demonstrating entitlement resolution. That avoids a manifest edit if no UI-facing plan details change.
- Identity evidence: The publisher portal requires either tenant claim + SPN proof OR a signed letter from tenant admin. The zip must include tenant id, SPN id, and a public key/certificate thumbprint used by your token-exchange flow.
- Sandbox token-exchange failures: Please upload the failing traces (sanitized). We will replay in staging and flag the failing component (token exchange or entitlement lookup).

Please open a support case here: https://aka.ms/marketplace-support and attach the bundle. If you want a faster path, reply to this thread after you've uploaded and we'll triage directly.

Regards,
Azure Marketplace Support

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure offer gatekeeper checklist: account binding + technical acceptance

Team,

I'll join the sandbox replay tomorrow at 10:30 PT. Quick plan:
- Priyom: please upload the acme_identity_evidence.zip to the support case and include the SPN README (we need SPN, tenant id, cert thumbprint).
- Karthik: please be ready to capture the entitlement mapping from the offer JSON and confirm the SKU IDs we plan to publish. If the SKU IDs are ephemeral, call that out.
- Vivek: if publishing windows are tight, we can request a one-time expedited gate review — requires a short note to the marketplace PM (I can draft).

Patrick: can you confirm whether ACME's security team prefers the signed letter route or the SPN bundle? If signed letter, we need the contact (name/email) for routing.

Thanks,
Marissa

Folks,

Uploaded: acme_identity_evidence.zip and staging-test-results-20261118.txt to the support case (case id 20261118-REDWOOD-ACME).
Attachment summary:
- acme_identity_evidence.zip -> tenant-id.txt (tenant: 5f3b...c12), spn.txt (spn: 8a2e...b7), cert_thumbprint.txt, README.md
- staging-test-results-20261118.txt -> token-exchange trace and entitlement lookup trace (sanitized)

Patrick: ACME confirmed via Slack that they will provide the SPN bundle (no signed letter). Patrick, please confirm here so Azure can proceed with the replay.

Marissa / Karthik: logs show a 401 on token-exchange when the token audience is set to the ARM resource ID rather than the publisher SPN. I suspect our token-exchange is passing the wrong resource param for Azure AD v2. We'll walk through during the replay.

Next steps:
- Azure: please confirm receipt and ETA for replay.
- ACME: confirm SPN upload success.
- Redwood: join 10:30 PT sandbox replay (calendar invite sent).

Thanks — Priyom

Update after replay: Azure confirmed the failure source as token-exchange audience mismatch and accepted the entitlement evidence bundle. They marked the case as "technical acceptance pending" while the SPN cert rotates.

Action items we closed:
- ACME uploaded SPN bundle (verified).
- Azure accepted entitlement evidence in lieu of a manifest change — no edit required.
- Redwood to push a small token-audience fix to the staging hook and rerun the smoke test (I've already opened PR #1842).

Open items:
- Azure requested a one-time signed acceptance note for expedited publish window (they provided a DocuSign link). Marissa — can you sign/approve? If you want, I can draft the note.

Otherwise this looks green for production once the staging smoke passes and the DocuSign is complete. Nice job everyone.

Karthik
